_meta.note: Auto-categorized from Capital Electric purchase history. enabled=false by default — user opts in to ones they actually use. GreenKey-specific items (gk-* prefix) are enabled by default since they are required for standard installs.

items.name: Hubbell HBL9450A NEMA 14-50 Outlet (EV-rated, industrial spec)
items.notes: EV-grade, 90C terminals, continuous-duty rated. Required for EV NEMA 14-50 installs (NOT a residential range/RV outlet).

items.name: Interior Outlet Box + Surface Extension (for NEMA 14-50)
items.notes: Standard interior surface-mount box plus extension for NEMA 14-50 outlet. Combined cost line item.

items.name: Outdoor NEMA 14-50 Enclosure with EV Outlet (Home Depot)
items.notes: Pre-assembled outdoor enclosure with NEMA 14-50 EV outlet. Free delivery from HD. If HD discontinues, individual component cost will be significantly higher.

items.name: Eaton BRH260 60A 2-Pole Breaker (BR panel safety upgrade)
items.notes: REQUIRED on Eaton BR panels carrying EV loads. Replaces standard BR260 which has melted under continuous EV duty. GreenKey safety standard — no exceptions.

items.name: Access Cover, Plastic (drywall opening)
items.notes: Pop-in plastic cover for drywall access openings made during wire fishing. Customer-friendly finish — easier and cleaner than patching.

items.name: Polaris Lug (insulated, splice connector)
items.notes: Used at junction points for hot-conductor splices. Typically 2 per junction box (one per hot). Grounds spliced with large wire nuts.

items.name: Junction Box, Metal (interior)
items.notes: Standard metal junction box for interior splice points.

items.name: Junction Box, Plastic Outdoor-Rated
items.notes: Weather-rated junction box for exterior splice points. Used when wire transitions from interior to exterior or at outdoor termination points.
